name: Malagor the Dark Omen
canonNotes: A winged Great Bray-Shaman whose appearance heralds disaster, gathering the herds for the Dark Gods.
Hates cities and all works of civilisation; a prophet of ruin.
voiceNotes: Ominous, prophetic and cryptic; speaks in omens and curses.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
